# Mohammed Alagab (Mo Alagab) — محمد العجب

> Brand designer and AI product builder based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. From idea to a working system: Mo designs the brands and experiences customers see, and builds the products and AI systems that make the work happen behind them. Over 12 years across Sudan, Oman and Saudi Arabia. The site is Arabic-first (root paths) with an English version under /en.

## Service lines

Each service page answers the buyer's first questions: what it is, who it is for, what you receive, what is not included, how long it takes, cost and the steps.

- [AI & Digital Solutions](https://moalagab.art/en/services/digital): websites, business apps, AI agents and automations that connect systems, teams and data, including CRM development and ERP integration.
- [Events, Exhibitions & Brand Experiences](https://moalagab.art/en/services/experiential): creative concepts, booth and interactive space design, creative and technical direction, production coordination and on-site execution.
- [Brand & Creative Solutions](https://moalagab.art/en/services/brand): strategy, positioning, visual identities, communication systems, campaigns and marketing materials.
- [Business & Operations Solutions](https://moalagab.art/en/services/operations): workflow mapping, standard operating procedures (SOPs), project management, follow-up and performance measurement.

## Key pages

- [Work (case studies)](https://moalagab.art/en/work): selected projects with context, decision and delivered system.
- [About](https://moalagab.art/en/about): background, principles and career timeline.

- [Start a project](https://moalagab.art/en/start): three-step brief form; replies within two business days.
